source.title: Common English words chosen for each age group (starter list). Meanings and sentences are original to this project.
source.license: Reference only (the page describes the kind of list this was modelled on). No list was copied: words, meanings and sentences were written for this project and are released with it.

words.meaning: a place where you can borrow books
words.sentence: I borrowed three books from the library.

words.meaning: something you did not expect
words.sentence: The party was a big surprise.

words.meaning: land with water all the way around it
words.sentence: We sailed to a small island.

words.meaning: going one way without bending or turning
words.sentence: Draw a straight line with the ruler.

words.meaning: how strong someone or something is
words.sentence: It takes strength to lift the box.

words.meaning: to make something by putting parts together
words.sentence: We will build a tree house.

words.meaning: how tall something is
words.sentence: The height of the old tree surprised us.

words.meaning: to picture something in your mind
words.sentence: Imagine a castle in the clouds.

words.meaning: a short time of sixty seconds
words.sentence: Wait one minute, please.

words.meaning: to go out of sight
words.sentence: The magician made the coin disappear.

words.meaning: the details of where a person lives or works
words.sentence: Write your address on the envelope.

words.meaning: touching or opposed to something
words.sentence: He leaned the ladder against the wall.

words.meaning: very nearly, but not quite
words.sentence: We are almost at the top of the hill.

words.meaning: to feel sure that something is true
words.sentence: I believe what the teacher said.
words.tip: Never believe a lie: there is a 'lie' in be-lie-ve.

words.meaning: a structure that carries a road or path over water
words.sentence: We walked across the bridge.

words.meaning: got something by paying for it
words.sentence: She bought a new notebook.

words.meaning: a large old building with thick walls, where kings and queens lived
words.sentence: We visited a castle on the hill.

words.meaning: a period of one hundred years
words.sentence: A century is a hundred years.

words.meaning: to go up something using your hands and feet
words.sentence: We climb the hill every Sunday.
words.tip: There is a silent 'b' at the end.

words.meaning: to gather things together
words.sentence: I collect shells at the beach.

words.meaning: a large group of people in one place
words.sentence: A big crowd came to watch the match.

words.meaning: a piece of cloth that hangs over a window
words.sentence: She closed the curtain at night.

words.meaning: the chance that something bad could happen
words.sentence: The sign warns of danger.

words.meaning: to make up your mind
words.sentence: I cannot decide which book to read.

words.meaning: to tell what something is like
words.sentence: Can you describe the thief?

words.meaning: a hard, clear, sparkling jewel
words.sentence: The ring has a small diamond.

words.meaning: having nothing inside
words.sentence: The box is empty.

words.meaning: a machine that makes a car or train move
words.sentence: The engine started with a roar.

words.meaning: to like doing something
words.sentence: I enjoy swimming on hot days.

words.meaning: known by many people
words.sentence: She is a famous singer.

words.meaning: at last, after a long time
words.sentence: We finally reached the top.

words.meaning: a large area covered with trees
words.sentence: We walked through the forest.

words.meaning: an exciting or unusual journey or experience
words.sentence: Their adventure began at dawn.

words.meaning: very, very old
words.sentence: We saw ancient coins in the museum.

words.meaning: kept apart, not joined together
words.sentence: Put the red and blue pens in separate boxes.

words.meaning: not the same
words.sentence: Cats and dogs are different animals.

words.meaning: something that holds your attention
words.sentence: That was an interesting story.

words.meaning: a chart that shows the days, weeks and months of a year
words.sentence: I wrote the date on the calendar.

words.meaning: a little afraid or worried about something
words.sentence: I felt nervous before the show.

words.meaning: something you ask when you want to know
words.sentence: May I ask a question?

words.meaning: a test to find something out in science
words.sentence: We did an experiment with magnets.

words.meaning: moving your body to stay fit
words.sentence: I do some exercise every morning.

words.meaning: toward the front
words.sentence: Take one step forward.

words.meaning: being able to do what you choose
words.sentence: The birds enjoy their freedom.

words.meaning: soft and kind, not rough
words.sentence: Be gentle with the kitten.

words.meaning: a person who protects a place
words.sentence: The guard stood at the gate.

words.meaning: to give an answer when you are not sure
words.sentence: Can you guess my age?

words.meaning: a person who shows others the way
words.sentence: The guide led us through the cave.

words.meaning: how well your body is
words.sentence: Good food is important for your health.

words.meaning: the organ in your chest that pumps blood
words.sentence: Your heart beats faster when you run.

words.meaning: the study of the past
words.sentence: We learned about ancient Egypt in history.

words.meaning: telling the truth
words.sentence: An honest person does not cheat.

words.meaning: to get better or make better
words.sentence: Practice will help you improve.

words.meaning: to go up in size or number
words.sentence: Prices increase every year.

words.meaning: in place of something else
words.sentence: Have an apple instead of a sweet.

words.meaning: to make something that never existed before
words.sentence: Who was the first to invent the telephone?

words.meaning: a trip from one place to another
words.sentence: The journey took three hours.

words.meaning: words people use to speak and write
words.sentence: She speaks a second language.

words.meaning: a flash of bright light in the sky during a storm
words.sentence: We saw lightning and then heard thunder.

words.meaning: a thing with moving parts that does a job
words.sentence: The machine sorted the letters.

words.meaning: what something is made of
words.sentence: Wool is a warm material.

words.meaning: something you take to get better when you are ill
words.sentence: The doctor gave me medicine.

words.meaning: to say something briefly
words.sentence: Did she mention the party?

words.meaning: two or more things mixed together
words.sentence: The cake is a mixture of eggs, flour and sugar.

words.meaning: something strange that is hard to explain
words.sentence: The missing key is still a mystery.

words.meaning: plants, animals and the natural world
words.sentence: We love walking in nature.

words.meaning: to see or become aware of something
words.sentence: Did you notice the new sign?

words.meaning: to watch carefully
words.sentence: We observe the moon through a telescope.

words.meaning: what you think or believe about something
words.sentence: In my opinion, the film was too long.

words.meaning: normal, not special
words.sentence: It was an ordinary Tuesday.

words.meaning: going in the same direction and always the same distance apart
words.sentence: The two roads run parallel.
words.tip: Two l's in the middle, one at the end.

words.meaning: able to wait calmly
words.sentence: Be patient, it will be ready soon.

words.meaning: maybe
words.sentence: Perhaps it will rain later.

words.meaning: liked by many people
words.sentence: That game is very popular.

words.meaning: the place where something is
words.sentence: Stand in the starting position.

words.meaning: able to happen or be done
words.sentence: Is it possible to visit tomorrow?

words.meaning: having great strength or control
words.sentence: A powerful engine drives the ship.

words.meaning: needed, something you must have
words.sentence: Water is necessary for plants to grow.
words.tip: One collar and two sleeves: one c and two s.

words.meaning: the natural world around us
words.sentence: We should look after the environment.

words.meaning: the group of people who run a country
words.sentence: The government makes new laws.

words.meaning: what you know from learning and experience
words.sentence: Reading builds your knowledge.

words.meaning: to share ideas or news with other people
words.sentence: We can communicate by phone or letter.

words.meaning: without any doubt
words.sentence: I will definitely be there.

words.meaning: to say that something is good and worth trying
words.sentence: I recommend this book.

words.meaning: a place where you pay to eat a meal
words.sentence: We ate dinner at a restaurant.

words.meaning: having done what you hoped to do
words.sentence: The school fair was successful.

words.meaning: how hot or cold something is
words.sentence: The temperature dropped overnight.

words.meaning: to say what you think will happen
words.sentence: Scientists can predict the weather.

words.meaning: to get ready
words.sentence: We prepare dinner at six.

words.meaning: a pushing force, or a feeling of being rushed
words.sentence: The pressure in the ball is low.

words.meaning: likely to happen
words.sentence: It will probably rain tonight.

words.meaning: how good or bad something is
words.sentence: This shirt is good quality.

words.meaning: an amount of something
words.sentence: A large quantity of rain fell.

words.meaning: fair and sensible
words.sentence: That is a reasonable price.

words.meaning: to get something that is given or sent
words.sentence: I will receive a letter tomorrow.
words.tip: I before e except after c.

words.meaning: a large area of a country or the world
words.sentence: This region is known for its hills.

words.meaning: closely connected to what is being talked about
words.sentence: Only bring relevant papers.

words.meaning: in charge of something, and able to be trusted
words.sentence: You are responsible for feeding the fish.

words.meaning: important, or not joking
words.sentence: This is a serious problem.

words.meaning: your name written in your own writing
words.sentence: Please add your signature at the bottom.

words.meaning: almost the same
words.sentence: The twins have similar voices.

words.meaning: the way things are at a certain time
words.sentence: The situation is under control.

words.meaning: all the bones in a body
words.sentence: The museum has a whale skeleton.

words.meaning: a person in an army
words.sentence: The soldier stood guard.

words.meaning: the answer to a problem
words.sentence: We found a solution to the puzzle.

words.meaning: a small animal with a bushy tail that climbs trees
words.sentence: The squirrel hid a nut.

words.meaning: something that has been built, or how parts are arranged
words.sentence: The bridge is a strong structure.

words.meaning: happening quickly and without warning
words.sentence: Suddenly the lights went out.

words.meaning: to put forward an idea
words.sentence: I suggest we leave early.

words.meaning: to think something is likely
words.sentence: I suppose you are right.

words.meaning: the top or outside part of something
words.sentence: The surface of the lake was calm.

words.meaning: to stay alive in a dangerous situation
words.sentence: Plants need water to survive.

words.meaning: feeling sorry for someone who is sad or hurt
words.sentence: She showed sympathy for her friend.

words.meaning: machines and tools made with scientific knowledge
words.sentence: Modern technology helps us talk to far-away friends.

words.meaning: cars, buses and trucks moving along a road
words.sentence: The traffic was slow this morning.

words.meaning: very large or very great
words.sentence: There was a tremendous roar from the crowd.

words.meaning: not common or normal
words.sentence: That is an unusual hat.

words.meaning: something such as a car or bus that carries people or things
words.sentence: A vehicle must stop at a red light.

words.meaning: how loud a sound is, or how much space something takes up
words.sentence: Please turn down the volume.

words.meaning: a wild area where few people live
words.sentence: They camped in the wilderness.

words.meaning: those same people, used when they do something to or for their own selves
words.sentence: The children made lunch themselves.

words.meaning: one special thing and not any other
words.sentence: I like this particular song.

words.meaning: the taste of a food or drink
words.sentence: The ice cream has a strawberry flavor.

words.meaning: a safe place by the sea where boats stay
words.sentence: The fishing boats stayed in the harbor.

words.meaning: going from one place to another, often far away
words.sentence: We are traveling by train today.

words.meaning: a unit for measuring length, a little longer than a yard
words.sentence: The table is one meter long.

words.meaning: rings, necklaces and bracelets that people wear
words.sentence: She keeps her jewelry in a small box.

words.meaning: a soft, fuzzy growth that appears on old food
words.sentence: There was mold on the old bread.

words.meaning: a farm tool pulled across a field to turn over the soil
words.sentence: The farmer used a plow before planting.
